correctness.rationale: For b>=2 the -1 adjacency eigenspace is exactly the direct sum of zero-sum subspaces of all clique cells: peripheral equations S_j+S_0=0 and core equation S_0+sum_j S_j=0 force all S_j=0. E_{-1}=direct sum (I_t-J_t/t). Its Schur square has spectrum (t-1)/t on constants and (t-2)/t on cell contrasts, yielding only size-two differences and, if a=1, the hub singleton as potential kernel. Other spectral projectors annihilate size-two cell differences; the positive Perron projector removes the singleton hub. This establishes both inclusions and exact rank. For a>=2 the gap of the -1 Schur square is >=1/3; PSD addition preserves the lower bound on the common orthogonal complement. Any t=3 contrast gives equality because all other projectors have constant columns on that cell. Six exact projector checks and 77 separately diagonalized graphs corroborate but do not prove the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Unweighted clique-cored windmills represent many densely connected subnetworks glued to a complete core. The theorem exhaustively identifies which local clique sizes destroy long-time quantum mixing modes for arbitrary heterogeneous sizes and core order, and gives a sharp 1/3 positive spectral gap independent of total graph order for cores of size >=2. This is a structural all-parameter classification, distinct from known finite spectra or mere relabeling of uniform single-hub cases.
